header.running_head: Imaan (Belief) in What is to Happen on the Day of Qiyaamah

blocks.text: made the people delay in matters of the Aakhirah and what has made them oblivious of it?" "Their desires and Shaytaan," Hadhrat Anas (RA) replied. "No, by Allaah!" Hadhrat Abu Moosa (RA) said, "It is because the world is before them and the Aakhirah is still to come. Had they witnessed the Aakhirah, they would never turn away from it and never incline towards the world."[^1]
Imaan (Belief) in What is to Happen on the Day of Qiyaamah
Rasulullaah ﷺ's Desire for his Ummah to Comprise of Half the people of Jannah
Hadhrat Imraan bin Husayn (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ was on a journey when the verse was revealed:

blocks.arabic_text: يٰٓأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيْمٌ يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى النَّاسَ سُكٰرٰى وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكٰرٰى وَلٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللّٰهِ شَدِيْدٌ
blocks.text: O people! Fear (the punishment of) your Rabb (by obeying His commands). The earthquake of (the Day of) Qiyaamah is a tremendous thing indeed. When you will witness the day (of Qiyaamah), (you will see that people will be so frightened and worried that) every nursing mother will forget her suckling infant and every pregnant woman will abort (her unborn child). You will also see people in a drunken stupor although they will not be drunk, but (they will be in this condition because they will realise that) Allaah's punishment is severe (Worried that they should not have to face His punishment, people will be oblivious of everything else). {Surah Hajj, verses 1,2}

Rasulullaah ﷺ then asked the Sahabah (RA), "Do you know what day is that?" "Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ know best," the Sahabah (RA) submitted. Rasulullaah ﷺ then explained, "That will be the day when Allaah shall say to Aadam (AS), 'Dispatch the people of Jahannam.' 'O my Rabb!' Aadam (AS) will say, 'Who are those to be dispatched to Jahannam?' Allaah will reply, '(From every thousand) Nine hundred and ninety nine shall go to Jahannam and one will go to Jannah.'"
This made the Sahabah (RA) weep. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said to them, "Adopt moderation and continue treading the straight path. Remember that before the coming of every Nabi is a period of ignorance. The quota (for Jahannam) will first be completed from these people. Otherwise (if they are not sufficient), it will be completed from the Munaafiqeen.
